title: The l-adic field is the localization of its integers at a uniformizer
statement: Let $E/\Ql$ be a finite extension with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi_E$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Then the inclusion $\mathcal O_E\subset E$ makes $E$ a localization of $\mathcal O_E$ at $\varpi_E$ [def-weil-ring-localization-away]: the induced ring map $\mathcal O_E[1/\varpi_E]\to E$, $x/\varpi_E^n\mapsto x\varpi_E^{-n}$, is an isomorphism. Consequently, for every $\mathcal O_E$-module $M$, $M\otimes_{\mathcal O_E}\mathcal O_E[1/\varpi_E]\cong M\otimes_{\mathcal O_E}E$ as $E$-modules.
